board: Adafruit Universal Thermocouple Amplifier MAX31856 Breakout (product 3263)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico. The sim encodes the 19-bit thermocouple value (0Ch-0Eh, 0.0078125 C/LSB) and the 14-bit cold-junction value (0Ah-0Bh, 0.015625 C/LSB) as the datasheet specifies. The driver uses CPHA=1, a 1-shot conversion with the datasheet tCONV, and checks the fault status.
